degree: Bachelor's, Master's, PhD, One-Year Chinese Language Program
official_source: Embassy of the People's Republic of China in Bangladesh
duration: Duration of the degree program or one year for language program
description: The Embassy of the People's Republic of China in Bangladesh invites Bangladeshi students to apply for the Chinese Government Scholarship (CGS) - Type A, administered by the China Scholarship Council. The award covers study at Chinese universities in Bachelor's, Master's, Doctoral (PhD) and one-year Chinese language programmes. All applications are submitted online through the China Scholarship Council portal. The Embassy published the 2025/2026 call with a closing date of 10 January 2026.
